question: In Renal cell Phase 3 trials, classify the control arm as active, placebo, or best supportive care.

steps.desc: Filter Renal Cell phase 3 trials and select control arm text.
Map free text to controlled control arm categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Control arm and emit JSON {NCT, PMID, control_arm_type} with label in ["active","placebo","best supportive care","unknown"]. Heuristics: active if it mentions another treatment/drug; placebo if it mentions placebo; best supportive care if it mentions best supportive care/BSC; unknown if insufficient. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
